notes: Demo card set, balanced with the Power Level system: every card's kit sums
to its tier budget (Bronze 10 · Silver 15 · Gold 20 · Diamond 25 PL) using
the price table in src/engine/balance.ts — enforced by the balance audit
test. All demo cards ship at Bronze; tier-ups add player-chosen +5 PL paths.
power semantics: a FLAT base amount. At cast time the caster's scaling stat
(physical→Attack, magical→Magic Power, true damage→higher of the two) is
ADDED flat on top — damage/heal/shield scale linearly, never multiplicatively.
TRUE heals/shields are pure flat (no stat added).
Card-book expansion (2026-07-29, +36 bronze) — see docs/card-book-expansion.md.
Slices: wheel elements (fire/lightning/nature/frost), weapons (lance/bow),
archetypes (defensive/support/healing/true). Each element/weapon gets a
distinct play identity per the doc: fire=burn/DoT, lightning=speed/stagger,
nature=poison/regen, frost=slow/control, lance=reach/guard, bow=multi-hit/
precision. All authored at Bronze; tierUpgrades added only where the
auto-scaler can't express a sane curve (DoT-sink cards and pure-aura cards).
Vocabulary-fill pass (2026-08-18) \u2014 three synergy themes plus three empty
archetype x type cells. `ward` shipped on zero cards before this pass; it
is the only PREVENTIVE answer to anti-heal (heal/lifesteal cut 20% per
affliction category, floor -60%) \u2014 cleanse and TRUE heals only clean up
after the fact. `MAX_WARD_CHARGES` (3) clamps a holder's TOTAL ward
charges across every source, so a kit's own charge count is never additive
with another ward card's \u2014 see the per-card notes below for how that
shaped Aegis of the Unbroken.

Hybrid + depth pass (2026-08-18b): deepened ward/thorns/bleed/poison and authored keyword-pair bridges the user asked for by name (heal+thorns, shield+thorns) plus the heal -> ward -> thorns chain (sanctum_thorn, bramblemend, warded_reprisal, bulwark_thicket, unbreakable_stance, umbral_ward, thorn_shackle, mortal_wound, barbed_rampart, crippling_gore, poison_bloom, poison_ritual, evasive_cordon). See content-designer notes on each card for its balance derivation.

def.text: Deal 18 (+MATK) Lightning damage · +4 more if the target already carries a stat debuff (checked before this card acts).
notes: THE GENERALIST — `exploit` keyed to `debuff`, which is ONE status kind
covering all four `debuffStat` targets (attack/magicPower/armor/
magicResist all land as the same `{ kind: 'debuff' }` status,
combat/interpreter.ts's `debuffStat` arm), not four separate checks —
so this card fires off ANY stat-down the board already applied
(armor_break, hex_of_frailty, scorching_brand, slow_hex, ...), which is
what makes it the generalist rather than a lane-specific payoff.
`debuff` is in `ExploitableStatus` but NOT `StackedStatus` (it carries
no stack count, only a pct+turns pair), so `exploit`'s flat form is the
only shape available — same structural reason as control_opportunist's
stun. PURE exploiter (no debuffStat of its own): it stays the
conditional-trigger discount rather than forfeiting it, and reads as a
true generalist rather than one more debuff-applying card competing for
the same board slot as the appliers it punishes-for.
`amount` is a MULTIPLE OF 4 at every tier — not a style choice: exploit
prices at strikeRate/2 = 2.5 deci/pt, and `powerLevelBreakdown`'s
every-part-is-a-whole-PL rule (tests/engine/balance.test.ts) rejects any
amount whose price lands on a half-PL (e.g. 10 → 25 deci = 2.5 PL).
Hand-authored so both lines grow every tier:
Bronze:  exploit amount 4 (10) + damage 18 (90) = 100.
Silver:  exploit amount 8 (20) + damage 26 (130) = 150.
Gold:    exploit amount 12 (30) + damage 34 (170) = 200.
Diamond: exploit amount 16 (40) + damage 42 (210) = 250.
